bindings.source: The gallery gathers images used in Saint Charbel devotion: a crowd scene, a sepia portrait, an image shared with a testimony account, the historic photograph of Saint Charbel, and a series of AI-assisted devotional portraits and comparison images, each clearly labeled. Click any image to open it full-screen and move through the collection with the arrow keys.
"One thing I have asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life. That I may see the delight of the Lord, and may visit his temple."
The images here are made for quiet looking. Stay with one as long as you like.
Tip: click any image to open full view. Use arrow keys to navigate.
Saint Charbel Makhlouf (1828-1898) - the historic photograph kept of the saint. Photographer unknown. Wikimedia Commons identifies this photograph as public domain.

The creator of this website reports seeing Saint Charbel on December 22. This artistic rendition reflects his personal account, not independent verification or a photograph. AI transformation, series candidate 1: an AI-assisted imagined portrait.
AI transformation, not a photograph. Series, candidate 2: an AI-assisted imagined portrait in a stone hermitage.
AI transformation, not a photograph. Series, before and after: the historic image (left) beside the final rendition (center) and an alternate take (right).
AI transformation, not a photograph. Series, alternate take: an AI-assisted close portrait based on the historic photograph.

AI transformation, not a photograph. Series, final: an AI-assisted close portrait of Saint Charbel in an imagined hermitage, based on the historic photograph above. It shows how he might have looked and is not a record of any real scene.
- photographer unknown; listed as public domain by Wikimedia Commons.

): the AI transformation series made for this site. The final, alternate final and final comparison strip use the historic photograph in Image 4 as their reference. The earlier candidates are imagined portraits with no verified historic-source claim. These are illustrations, not photographs or a historical record, shown for devotional illustration only.

This gallery brings together the images used on the site: a black-and-white scene of a crowd gathered around a monk, the familiar sepia devotional portrait, an image shared with an apparition testimony, the historic photograph of Saint Charbel, and a series of AI-assisted devotional portraits and comparison images, each labeled as an illustration. The links below each image show the credited source. The testimony image is presented as part of that account, not independent proof of an apparition.
Four photographs, each with its source linked in the Image Sources section above, plus a series of labeled AI transformations.
Devotional and testimony images, with source links.
Full-screen viewing with keyboard navigation: click an image, then use the arrow keys.

Images used in Saint Charbel devotion: a crowd scene, a sepia devotional portrait, an image shared with an apparition testimony, the historic photograph of Saint Charbel, and a series of AI-assisted devotional portraits and comparison images, each labeled as an illustration and not a photograph. Each image has its source or origin noted on the page.
Where do the images come from?
Every image has its source listed in the Image Sources section on this page, with a link, so you can see where each photograph was found.
How do I view an image full-screen?
Click any image to open the full view, then move through the collection with the Previous and Next buttons or the arrow keys on your keyboard.
A source credit is not permission to reuse an image. Check the rights with the source before copying or sharing it.
Grainy archival black-and-white photograph of a crowd gathered around a monk, from the Saint Charbel devotion archive
Sepia archival close-up photograph of Saint Charbel's face
Black-and-white testimony photograph showing two figures, shared with a Saint Charbel apparition account
Historic photograph of Saint Charbel with lowered eyes, wearing his monastic hood
AI transformation, not a photograph: Saint Charbel in a black cap and heavy black robe, eyes lowered, dark beard with a grey center streak, against a plain stone-colored wall
AI transformation, not a photograph: Saint Charbel in a black hood and robe, eyes lowered, seated in a stone hermitage room beside a window and a clay jug
AI transformation comparison strip, not a photograph: the historic image of Saint Charbel on the left beside two AI transformations with a window behind him
AI transformation, not a photograph: close portrait of Saint Charbel in a black hood, eyes lowered, white beard, a window blurred behind him, alternate take
AI transformation, not a photograph: close portrait of Saint Charbel in a black monastic hood, eyes lowered, with a full dark beard, a lit window blurred behind him
Gallery updated March 2, 2026. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
